best_hook.why: 'Guards! Remove her!' and a bride in white is seized and dragged from the church - violent, instant stop-scroll.

best_cliffhanger.why: Scarred stranger on one knee before the stunned congregation: 'Lady Juliana... accept my hand' - her answer is left hanging.

must_promos.why: Bride dragged out by guards, a mysterious stranger orders them off, flattens a guard with one punch, and it cuts on the groom yelling 'He's only one man!' - fight about to escalate.
Opens on the knockout punch, the stranger protects her and offers back the marriage they stole, and ends on his kneeling proposal before she answers.

standalone_risk: Neither cut shows why the family is throwing her out (the groom chose her sister); the stranger's identity and motive are unexplained, which works as mystery but could read as random.
